skills.name: add-fx
skills.description: Add juicy feedback with fx-kit: particles, screen shake, flash, score popups, day-night sky, parallax and foreground silhouettes.
steps: `createParticles({seed, max})`; `burst('splash'|'dust'|'sparkle'|'confetti'|'poof', x, y)` at event time; `update(dt)`; `draw(ctx)`.
`createShake()` (`kick`, integer `offset()`), `createFlash()`, `createPopups()` for score text.
Sky: `skyRamp(DAY_NIGHT_STOPS, t01)`, `drawSkyBands`; backgrounds: `parallaxOffsets(layers, camX, tileW)`; `makeSilhouetteStrip('trees'|'hills'|'grass', w, h)`.
Trigger fx from sim events, never from render state.

skills.name: add-physics-hazards-worldgen
skills.description: Add platformer physics, hazards, seeded level generation, fairness validation and an autopilot using the src/lib kits.
steps: Import from `src/lib/`: `platformer-physics.js` (fixed step), `hazard-kit.js` (behaviour registry), `world-gen.js` (rule table + validator), `autopilot-kit.js` (bot parts).
Put numbers in `TUNING` in the shared defs file; use `jumpRange`/`jumpHeight` from the lib to derive `MAX_PIT`.
Write a sweep script first for any reach geometry (vines, ropes) and tune from its output.
Generate with per-screen seeded streams; validate with a reachability predicate; add a "different seed gives different output" test.
Stagger cyclers (phase = `i * period / 3`).

skills.name: choose-model-per-agent
skills.description: Choose the cheapest adequate model tier (haiku, sonnet, opus) for each swarm agent or subagent task.
steps: List agents and give each a one-line difficulty note.
Default to sonnet for modules, haiku for tooling and mechanical work.
Put the choice in the manifest header: `## id | model | phase | role | Name`.
Always pass `model` explicitly when spawning a subagent.

skills.name: choose-style
skills.description: Pick and apply a game style preset (pixel 8-bit, 16-bit, raycaster, low-poly 3D, isometric, ASCII, vector) with theme and palette policy.
steps: `styles.recommend {idea, constraints: {platform, team, budget, device}}` ranks presets with reasons and trade-offs.
`styles.show {id, themes: true}` for the full preset and compatible themes.
`styles.apply {project, style, theme?, dryRun: true}` then without dryRun; `yes` overwrites differing files.
Tag every asset you later publish `style:<id>`.

skills.name: compose-music-sfx
skills.description: Compose chiptune music and sound effects with audio-kit: recipe tables, tracker songs, offline WAV render, jingles and a soundtrack map.
steps: SFX: a pure-data recipe table `{ name: (v, {arp}) => { v({src, dur, gain, f}) } }`; preview with `describeSfx` and render offline with `renderSfx`.
Songs: `{bpm, bars, loop, channels, drums}`; one bar is exactly 16 sixteenths (`"D5:2 F#5:2 A5:4 .:8"`). Check every bar with `parseBar`.
Render with `renderSong(song, sr)` and `toWav(pcm, sr)`; write to `out/`.
Map states to tracks with `soundtrack({menu:'title', play:'jungle'})`; stings via `jingle`.
Set master gain from measured peaks (peak <= 0.88).

skills.name: debug-common-failures
skills.description: Triage common game-factory and swarm failures: broken contract parsing, stale state, unreachable hazards, blank frames, flaky tests, swarm usage limits.
steps: Reproduce with the smallest test. 2. Change one thing at a time. 3. Add the regression test. 4. Record the lesson under "Learnings" in your report.

skills.name: export-3d-models
skills.description: Generate, convert, inspect and print-check 3D models (STL, OBJ+MTL, 3MF, GLB/glTF, PLY) for 3D printing, Blender and game engines.
steps: See formats, units and axes: `models.formats {}` (print files are mm, Z up; glTF is metres, Y up).
Generate from a JSON recipe: `models.generate {recipe, out, formats: ["stl","obj","glb","3mf"]}`; or convert an existing file: `models.convert {input, out, format}`.
Check: `models.inspect {input}` (bounds, triangles, volume, manifold) and `models.verify {input, bed: {x,y,z}}` (print readiness).
Prepare for printing: `models.print-prep {input, out, ...}` (drop to bed, scale or fit, optional plinth).
Confirm Blender opens it: `models.blender-check {files: [...]}` (3MF has no native Blender importer; the check uses a fallback parser).

skills.name: find-reuse-assets
skills.description: Find and reuse sprites, tilesets, sfx, songs and code kits from asset libraries via the registry, install them with hash verification.
steps: Register a source once: `registry.add {source: "owner/repo@ref" | "./local/path"}`, then `registry.refresh {}` (offline-safe: searches work from the cache).
Search: `registry.search {query: "cat sprite", type: "sprite", tag: "style:retro-8bit-sidescroller"}`; inspect with `registry.show {id}`.
Install: `library.install {project, registryId, assets: [ids], dryRun: true}` first, then without dryRun (add `yes` to overwrite).
Prove integrity: `library.verify {project}` against `assets.lock.json`.

skills.name: make-sprites-characters
skills.description: Make pixel-art sprites, tiles and animated characters with art-kit and character-kit, palette locked and viewed at x6.
steps: First look for existing art: `registry.search {query, type: "sprite", tag: "style:<id>"}`; install with `library.install`.
Otherwise lock a palette: `lockPalette({...})`; `lock.offenders(sprite)` must be empty.
Static art: `spriteFromAscii(rows, legend)` or `spriteFromFn`. Characters: a spec `{name,size,palette,outline,poses,anims}` through `buildCharacter`, play with `createAnimator`.
Pack: `packSheet(...)` then `validateManifest(manifest, sheet, requiredNames)`; write with `encodePng`.
Preview at x6 (`tools/sheet.mjs --only <substr>`), judge the smallest, lowest-contrast sprite.

skills.name: plan-run-swarm
skills.description: Plan an agent swarm for a game or tool: contract first, disjoint file ownership, one SWARM.md manifest, generated prompt files, waves under a concurrency cap.
steps: Write the contract (ARCHITECTURE.md + shared defs file) before launching anyone.
Draft the manifest: `guide.plan {goal, agents?}` gives a skeleton using `swarm/templates/SWARM.md`; fill `owns:` lists that never overlap.
Generate prompts: `npm run plan` (= `swarm-plan.mjs`). Spawn each agent with one line: "Read <root>/docs/swarm/prompts/<id>.md and execute it exactly."
Start with at most 4 agents running; launch critical-path agents first; plan waves (platform cap about 20 launches).
Each agent keeps `docs/swarm/progress/<id>.md` and ends with `CONTINUE: <step>` after about 25 tool calls; a fresh agent continues from it.
After each wave: re-run the suites yourself, commit, append to docs/CHECKPOINT.md.

skills.name: publish-library
skills.description: Create, validate, index and publish an asset library repo from a game project's art, sfx and songs.
needs: game project with a built sheet
steps: `library.new {name, dir, description, license, author}`.
`library.add {library, from: {project, adapter: "pixbuf-web", style, game}}` imports sprites, characters, tilesets, fx, sfx, songs with previews.
`library.validate {library}` then `library.index {library}`.
Plan the push: `library.publish {library, repo, visibility: "private"}` returns a CONFIRM_REQUIRED plan; run again with `yes: true` only after the user agrees.
Register it: `registry.add {source: "owner/repo"}`.

skills.name: qa-with-bot
skills.description: QA a game with an autopilot bot, headless smoke tests, screenshots and mutation checks instead of trusting "tests pass".
steps: Build the bot from `autopilot-kit.js`: look-ahead over the real hazard update functions, robust-plan smoothing, a no-progress watchdog, a `skill` knob. The game-specific state mirror stays in the game.
Run it over many seeds; assert it finishes levels and the watchdog never fires.
Mutation check: reintroduce the bug, confirm the test fails, restore.
Screenshots: `tools/shot.mjs` renders via a shim 2D context; check mean/std (std < 0.01 means blank).
`npm test` and re-run suites yourself before committing.

skills.name: setup-tracker
skills.description: Set up the swarm tracker (plan.json, live dashboard on port 4782, track.mjs reporting) for a project.
steps: `factory new --web` already copies it; for an older repo run `bin/factory sync <dir>`.
`npm run plan` (generates prompts and `.tracker/plan.json`), `npm run tracker` (http://127.0.0.1:4782/).
Agents report with `node tools/swarm-tracker/bin/track.mjs <id> start|progress|done`.
Add `.tracker/` and `docs/swarm/prompts/` to `.gitignore`.

skills.name: ship-github-pages
skills.description: Build the web game and ship it with its docs site to GitHub Pages (play/ build output, docs/ folder, repo push).
steps: `npm test` green; `guide.check` reports no errors.
Build the web package (`tools/web/pkg`) into the folder Pages serves; relative `play/` links need the build output there.
Generate docs (`write-docs-site`), commit, push.
Settings, Pages, branch main, folder /docs (or deploy `docs/site`). Add a build step; nothing builds it automatically.
Open the URL and play one level.

skills.name: start-new-game
skills.description: Scaffold a new zero-dependency web game (or Godot game) with tooling, kits, swarm tracker and a chosen style preset.
steps: Pick a style first (camera, render tech, palette policy, cost): `factory styles recommend "<idea>"` (capability `styles.recommend {idea, constraints}`).
Scaffold: `bin/factory new <dir> "<Title>" --web` (browser, zero deps) or without `--web` for Godot.
Apply the style: `styles.apply {project: <dir>, style: <id>}` writes `config/style.json`, `config/theme.json` and lists kits to install.
Write the contract before any agent runs: `ARCHITECTURE.md` plus a shared definitions file (`src/core/defs.js`: art rows, layout, palette, tuning).
`cd <dir> && npm test && npm start` (serves on port 4781).

skills.name: write-docs-site
skills.description: Generate README, HOW-TO-PLAY, HOW-IT-WAS-MADE and a GitHub Pages site from swarm reports and screenshots with docs-kit.
steps: Copy `examples/docs-config.example.json` to `docs.config.json`; fill title, tagline, controls.
Take screenshots with `tools/shot.mjs` into `out/shots`.
`node src/kits/docs-kit/cli.mjs docs.config.json . --reports docs/swarm/reports --shots out/shots`.
Hand-check numbers (counts, tests, sprites) against reality before committing.
